name: insider-motion-studio
description: Eight skills for motion design in code with Remotion: art direction and storyboards, kinetic typography, product promos from real screenshots, animated charts from CSV, word-timed captions, logo stings, beat-synced editing, and render review with contact sheets, platform checks, loudness and safe zones. Ships a Remotion project with eight styles; nine bundled Python scripts, standard library only.
